description: Crystal Canine default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/crystal_canine-character-sheet.png (intake.json swatch chips 247,234,224 / 217,198,198 / 217,188,180 / 153,137,146 / 81,74,81 + direct samples of the drawn surfaces, px cited per region). A slim cream-white fox-like canine with blush inner ears, grey eyes with dark pupils, a small dark nose, a faceted mauve-taupe forehead gem and a crystal mane of faceted prisms toned by the light. Matte. The ink outline and the painted lilac shading are drawing style, not regions. No glow (the sheet draws none): every region writes zero Glow.
